messages:
Lina (CS): Heads-up: TransitX API traffic down ~58% over last 10d. Seat pings low and automated jobs failing. New procurement lead (Hannah Li) started this week; engineering said they9re running a side-by-side perf eval with AeroVector. This looks like a renewal risk. Can we triage?

Ravi (Solutions): on it. Any 4xx/5xx spikes? looping in @Noah for logs.

Noah (Eng): Saw repeated 401/429 for org 554321 on 2025-04-02. Proxy snippets: `401 unauthorized: invalid_api_key` and `429 rate_limit_exceeded` back-to-back. Suspect key rotation + burst traffic from job retries.

Sam (Sales): Renewal in ~38 days (annual). If they9re testing AeroVector we need to (1) restore service fast, (2) offer a short perf window to stall. I can draft commercial terms.

Lina (CS): Proposed immediate playbook:
- Outreach: quick note to Hannah offering 30m triage call today (Ravi + Noah).
- Tech: confirm key in dashboard vs env; Noah to provide repro & ETA to rotate key if needed.
- Commercial: offer 10-day dedicated throughput trial (no charge) to prove perf; Sam to draft PO.
- CRM: tag reasons ["seat_activity_drop","procurement_change","competitive_test"] and mark renewal flag: at-risk until follow-up.

SupportBot: Ticket created TX-2042 "TransitX integration failures - invalid key / rate limits" https://support.redwood/tickets/TX-2042

Ravi (Solutions): Sending Hannah a short checklist: confirm API key value in env, check SDK >=1.5.0, run sample request and paste response.

Noah (Eng): I can rotate their key and add temporary rate-limit bump for the trial. ETA ~25m.

Sam (Sales): I'll prepare the trial cadence and fast-track legal language: "10-day dedicated burst, SLA 99.9%, complimentary".

Lina (CS): Booked 30m triage with Hannah + eng lead for today. Please update thread when TX-2042 is resolved and when trial PO is issued. I'll prepare an exec summary for CS leadership. :white_check_mark:
